sourceInputs.userInstruction: Prepare target-house-1 for a later sketch-to-real-BIM seed generation run. This draft is planning only and must not create seed artifacts.

requiredViews.purpose: Primary sketch-matched view proving white folded wrapper, front loggia, cantilever, vertical cladding, and roof terrace cutout.
High right/roof view proving the roof terrace is a real open void with occupied floor and return faces.
Front view proving the three-bay upper loggia, rail, ground openings, and vertical cladding.
Close oblique/detail view proving the recessed loggia depth, side returns, three-bay glazing, floor slab, and guard rail.
Rear/right view proving the cutout, shell thickness, carport recess, and side envelope.
Ground-floor room, door, stair, wet-room, utility, and carport sanity check.
First-floor rooms, landing, loggia, roof court, stair opening, and access sanity check.
Transparent/wire evidence for roof-wall seams, slab openings, room boundaries, and hidden overlaps.

contract.note: Final acceptance requires each required semanticChecks[] item to be agent-filled as pass with notes/evidence, or fail/unchecked will block acceptance.
